title: Featured drive
description: A ready-made trip shown on the home page in its season, opening trip mode with From and To filled in.

blurb.description: Why now, in a few words: "Oktoberfest in October, holiday lights in December".

from.description: A town, zip, address, place id, or "lat,lon" (coordinates avoid a place search).

from_label.description: Name to show when `from` is coordinates.

season.description: When it shows on the home page, month-day to month-day (may wrap past New Year). Without it, it shows all year.

state.description: So the home page can mix states.
